NotificationLogValue renders backend extra arrays as stateless recursive text/list/definition-list nodes. It has no per-entry input, hooks, effect, uncontrolled DOM or editing callbacks; JSON array entries may repeat and have no record ID. On detail replacement React reconciles current text at each position, so index identity cannot retain a prior row draft or submit incorrect data. Structured-extra tests cover nested arrays/objects and escaped markup.

The standalone em dash is the existing empty-value presentation for empty arrays/objects and null values, not sentence punctuation. Tests explicitly assert three empty markers and legacy missing-title/body markers in the structured log contract; changing this approved presentation solely to satisfy an AI-style heuristic would change user-visible output.

The flagged groups contain stored message title, body and extra values, each with an aria-label used by detail consumers. These are not contact information; replacing role=group with address would assert incorrect HTML semantics. Current tests query the named groups and verify complete escaped backend text.
